about: SCION 06 Whitney: what the dog did, measured from the drawn points of each scene frame. x_screen/y_screen: mean screen position of the drawn torso dots; x_world_measured: that screen point back-projected through the fixed camera onto the walking plane, in score metres; facing: 1 when the drawn chest is left of the drawn rump (toward the door), -1 when turned away; posture from the drawn shoulder height; head_below_back_m: withers height minus skull height (positive = head below the back).
